info.name: Board Game Rental API
info.description:
Full collection for the board game rental backend. 

**Prerequisites**
- `docker compose up -d`
- `docker compose run --rm backend python -m scripts.seed --reset --yes`

**Run order** — folders top-to-bottom via Collection Runner. Variables flow automatically.

**Notes**
- Client email is unique per run (`{{$guid}}`).
- Courier / manager / damage flows consume state from seed; re-run seed between full runs.
- Admin flow uses `admin@bgrent.io`. Client created in `01-Auth` is deactivated and reactivated in `12-Admin: Clients`.
- Cover upload in `09-Admin: Games` is skipped unless `cover_file_path` variable is set to an absolute path of a JPEG file on the machine running Postman.
- **Note on status codes:** POST /admin/{categories, pickup-points, games, employees, copies} return **201**, all other successful POSTs return **200**, DELETE returns **204**.

exec: pm.test('At least one ready order at point', () => pm.expect(ready.length).to.be.greaterThan(0));
